description: UP expands its digital economy push with semiconductor, data-centre and AI investments, including the ₹3,706-crore HCL-Foxconn project.
body_lead: Lucknow: Uttar Pradesh is positioning itself for a larger role in India’s digital economy, with the state expanding its technology ecosystem from electronics manufacturing to semiconductors, data centres and artificial intelligence. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said on Tuesday that Uttar Pradesh was moving from mobile-phone assembly towards microchip-related manufacturing and emerging technologies, linking the expansion to employment, entrepreneurship and investment.
